clause: Transform primitives: move, crop, perspective crop, free transform [STU-RAS-029]

scope.summary: Implement the core deduped transform primitives on layers, selections, and placed-asset containers, with both numeric and handle-based input and explicit typed units per [STU-DOC-003]: Move (with auto-select and layer-bounds hover); Crop (ratio/absolute presets, overlay guides incl. rule-of-thirds and golden-ratio, straighten, delete-vs-hide cropped pixels, crop-to-selection, content-aware fill of newly exposed areas on commit); Perspective crop (corner-handle keystone correction to a straight-on rectangle); Free transform (scale/rotate/skew/distort/flip in one interactive op with numeric entry and reference-point control).
acceptance_criteria: crop guides, straighten, delete-vs-hide, content-aware fill on commit; typed units
expected_tests: live: free-transform scale+rotate a layer with numeric entry + reference point and confirm resampled result; crop with a ratio preset and content-aware fill of exposed area on commit
live: perspective crop corrects a keystoned rectangle
test: transforms carry explicit typed units

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Move, crop & free transform

risk_if_missed: No transform/crop; foundational image geometry editing absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
